findings.title: Keep the registered metric-alert handler instantiable
findings.body: The empty StatefulDetectorHandler subclass leaves counter_names, get_dedupe_value, get_group_key_values, and build_occurrence_and_event_data abstract. MetricAlertFire still registers this class, and Detector.detector_handler instantiates registered handlers, so accessing the handler for a detector with type='metric_alert_fire' now raises TypeError. process_detectors does not catch this exception, so that detector aborts the batch instead of retaining the previous no-op behavior. Implement the required methods or retain a concrete placeholder returning an empty dict.

findings.title: Build the expected occurrence with the evaluated group key
findings.body: TestEvaluateGroupKeyValue.test_dedupe builds its expected occurrence with group_key='val1', but invokes evaluate_group_key_value with group_key='group_key'. The helper incorporates that key into the occurrence fingerprint, so the expected fingerprint ends in ':val1' while the actual fingerprint ends in ':group_key'. The result equality assertion therefore fails even with the correct implementation. Build the expected occurrence using 'group_key'.
